notes.content:
-Fixed a crash regarding empty lines
-Fixed a few typos

notes.title: Patch 1.8 - Miscellaneous
notes.content:
-Fixed various issues with credits
-Fixed an issue with pausing in Chapter 6
-Fixed various typos
-Fixed an issue with deleting saves and scrolling
-Fixed tutorial properly closing in Jay V
-Fixed an invisible hotspot in chapter 4

notes.title: Patch 1.6
notes.content:
-Fixed a typo in Chapter 3.
-Fixed a bug with UIs in Chapter 5.
-Fixed a text option typo in Chapter 3 intro.
-Fixed an issue with saves not showing the popup displaying the engine limit.
-Settings tool no longer crops resolution list.

notes.title: Patch 1.5
notes.content:
-Fixed a crash in chapter 6
-Fixed a rare crash with credits in Chapter 4.
-Fixed a crash with Nozzo and background dialogs.

We've been focusing on fixing game-breaking bugs so far! But we'll patch very soon again with the few typos that have been found! Thank you so much for playing!!

notes.title: Patch 1.4 - Partial Accessibility
notes.content:
-Fixed a lock in Chapter 2.
-If you go to your savegames folder and add a file called flicker.txt (it doesn't matter what's in it), it will fix 2 instances of flickering lights.

notes.title: Credits & Fia News Patch - 1.3
notes.content:
-Fixed an issue with the music overlapping during the credits
-Fixed an issue with the controller unable to skip a line in Fia News UI

notes.title: Crossplatform Patch
notes.content:
Thank you for the amazing support to Old Skies, we did a small, nevermind, I did a small mistake, but nobody will lose saves because of it, I tested like 20 thousand times!

This will allow saves to be fully crossplatform between all the 4 platforms!

notes.title: Time-travel adventure Old Skies from Wadjet Eye Games is out now
notes.content:
The latest point and click adventure from Wadjet Eye Games is out now with Old Skies sending you through time. It has Native Linux support and is Steam Deck Verified.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/04/time-travel-adventure-old-skies-from-wadjet-eye-games-is-out-now/

notes.title: Old Skies is OUT!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42288758/89b75e65820377846090b67c198b27fd0c37b9cd.png[/img]
As the subject title says, Old Skies has officially launched on Steam! 

Join ChronoZen agent Fia Quinn on a time-travel adventure spanning 200 years. Old Skies is a story of love, loss and legacy. Plus it's 10% off during the first week!

IMPORTANT NOTE: If you played the demo, the [b]SAVES DO NOT PERSIST[/b] to the main game. Sorry about that. Couldn't be avoided.

This game took almost five years to make and reaching this day doesn't seem real. I SO hope you enjoy it as much as I enjoyed making it. 

-Dave, Ben, et al

notes.title: Old Skies is now DECK VERIFIED!
notes.content: It took awhile to get through Valve's certification process, but Old Skies is ready to play on the Steam Deck when the game launches on April 23rd!

Wadjet Eye Games have announced their next game, the time-travelling adventure Old Skies, is now set for launch on April 23rd.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/03/time-travelling-adventure-old-skies-from-wadjet-eye-games-arrives-april-23/

notes.title: Old Skies has a launch date!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42288758/431b39e224178297690ecbb3f00a2fabe9716588.gif[/img]

After way too many years of production, you will no longer need a time machine to visit the future to play Old Skies because it is finally launching on [b]April 23rd, 2025[/b]! 

To celebrate, here is a sparkling new trailer featuring Hanna Takana, one the several clients you will be taking into the past:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nAQ9UMzqZUQ

And as always, you can wishlist the game right here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1346360/Old_Skies/

Thank you again! It won't be long now...

-Dave et al

notes.title: New demo available!
notes.content:
We are thrilled to announce that Old Skies will be out this spring! After 5 years in development, the wait is almost over. 

And if you just can’t wait another few months, lucky you: we’ve just released a BRAND NEW DEMO showcasing a slice of a never-before seen area of the game! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1346360/Old_Skies/]Download it here[/url]. (If you already had the old demo in your library, you just have to click Update to download the new one.)

Join time agent Fia Quinn as she travels to the 1870s to track down a champion boxer who rose to fame and then mysteriously disappeared from public life. A simple enough task, but nothing is straightforward when time travel is concerned.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42288758/431b39e224178297690ecbb3f00a2fabe9716588.gif[/img]

The demo contains about 30-40 minutes of gameplay and includes full voice acting, Steam Deck integration, bloopers, commentary, oysters, punching, a shootout, and more!

This new demo will only be live until February 20 as part of the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/GameOverT1DSale2025]Game Over, T1D! Steam sale[/url], a charity event we're participating with our friends at Breakthrough T1D Play. Unavowed is one of the 50+ games on sale ([url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/336140/Unavowed/]grab it for 65% off![/url]) and we'll make a donation to Breakthrough T1D (formerly known as JDRF) after the event to further their efforts to find cures for type 1 diabetes.

[b]About Old Skies[/b]
Fia Quinn is a time traveler, accompanying clients of the ChronoZen Time Travel Agency on jumps to other eras to make sure they don't rewrite important aspects of history. Some of these people are merely curious. Others have unresolved business. As long as they can pay for the trip, their motivations don't matter to Fia... until they do.

Jump with Fia into seven time-travel cases spanning two centuries in New York City, from the speakeasies of Prohibition to the vicious gangs of the Gilded Age to the World Trade Center on September 10, 2001. Solve temporal problems, survive paradoxes, and resolve the mistakes of the past or die trying -- as many times as it takes.

notes.title: Old Skies is coming SPRING OF 2025!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42288758/a8b04ef94c42e2ec914945c1645a24930ec32d0b.png[/img]

That's right. At long last, we are nearing the finish line. Old Skies is launching in Spring of 2025!

If you have a time machine, you can play it right now. If you don't have a time machine, you can tide yourself over with our new trailer:

https://youtu.be/SCiEk-LezlY?si=HWf2TdbzY3wHVBZx

And as always, you can wishlist the game right here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1346360/Old_Skies/

We know this has been a loooong road but we're nearly there. We're looking forward to sharing this game with all of you!

Thank you all,

-Dave et al

notes.title: Demo available!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! I'm happy to announce that Old Skies has a DEMO available to play during the Steam Next Fest event (which ends on June 20th)!

Some details:
- Has ~40-60 minutes of gameplay
- Full voice acting 
- Available on PC, Mac, and Linux
- Has commentary and bloopers (yes I went a bit overboard)
- It's about TIME TRAVEL

I hope you enjoy!

-Dave, et al
